title: Orthogonal inference for machine learning forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2611.33187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecast comparisons inform investment and other economic decisions, but machine learning forecasts can be trained under objectives that differ from the relevant losses. Estimation error can then create spurious evidence of predictive superiority, even with out-of-sample evaluation. We establish feasible inference for differences in population evaluation risks in this setting. Building on locally robust estimation, we construct scores that preserve the risk target and remove first-order estimation sensitivity. Under geometric beta-mixing, moment conditions and simultaneous learning bounds, we establish Gaussian limits and consistent long-run covariance estimation for overlapping chronological training windows, allowing refitting at every evaluation date. translated_title: 机器学习预测的正交推断
translated_abstract: 预测比较为投资及其他经济决策提供依据，但机器学习预测的训练目标可能与相关的评估损失不一致。在这种情况下，即使采用样本外评估，估计误差也可能制造出虚假的预测优越性证据。我们在该设定下建立了针对总体评估风险差异的可行推断。基于局部稳健估计，我们构造了既保持风险目标又消除一阶估计敏感性的得分函数。在几何β-混合、矩条件以及同步学习界的假设下，我们针对重叠的时间顺序训练窗口建立了高斯极限和一致的长程协方差估计，从而允许在每个评估日期进行重新训练。一致性扩展提供了对一类数据生成过程的置信覆盖；Wald推断要求校正得分的协方差非退化。对于稀疏线性预测……
tldr: 本文提出针对机器学习预测比较的正交推断方法，通过局部稳健得分消除估计误差导致的虚假预测优越性证据，并在数据存在相依性、允许滚动重新训练的条件下建立了风险评估差异的可行统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes orthogonal inference for machine learning forecast comparisons, constructing locally robust scores that remove estimation-error-induced spurious evidence of predictive superiority and establishing feasible inference for risk differences under dependent data with rolling refitting.
